lines.4: 「Tch, you noticed. Oh well, I did enough.」
lines.5: 「You. At least say something. Opening your eyes and finding somebody else in your house is pretty terrifying.」
lines.6: 「Ahaha! You can't scare anyone with a face like that!」
lines.7: 「You--did you draw all over my beautiful face?!」
lines.8: 「Well, you were making such a funny face in your sleep that I watched you from beside the bed for a while.」
lines.9: 「Then a marker happened to enter my field of vision.」
lines.10: 「At that point, there was only one thing to do.」
lines.11: 「Why the hell are you acting proud of it?!」
lines.13: She nimbly leaped through the window into the Kanisawa house next door.
lines.15: She was not strong, so once I caught her she was mine, but...
lines.18: Dealing with her really felt like handling a badly trained puppy.
lines.19: At least the marker was washable.
lines.20: I felt sorry for any guy who ended up dating her.
lines.21: I decided to clear my head by working on a ship in a bottle.
lines.22: 「The world inside this bottle... God, there's something irresistible about it. My darling... You drive me mad...」
lines.23: This hobby was my secret. Only Fukahire and the other two knew about it.
